decks.notes: The deck focuses on using various tools like Persist, Unburial Rites, and Faithful Mending to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Grief into play from the graveyard. By combining reanimation with disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while setting up powerful, game-winning combos. With access to a range of removal spells and card draw effects, the deck can efficiently control the battlefield and generate value to overwhelm opponents with its powerful reanimation game plan.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Prismari Command to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and ramp, while Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce offer additional removal and protection. The mana base ensures consistent colors for casting spells and activating abilities, making this combo deck both versatile and powerful.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, along with spells like Prismari Command and Indomitable Creativity, to create explosive and unexpected plays. The deck focuses on using a mix of removal, card advantage, and combo potential to disrupt the opponent's strategy and win the game through a mix of creature beatdowns and powerful combo finishes. The key strategy is to be versatile and creative in deploying resources to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling powerful equipment such as Colossus Hammer and Sword of Fire and Ice onto creatures like Gingerbrute and Ornithopter quickly with cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin. It utilizes efficient equipment tutors and protection, along with card advantage and disruption from cards like Esper Sentinel and Shadowspear. Urza's Saga helps find key pieces while providing a threat on its own. The deck aims to create a fast, explosive combo to overwhelm opponents and win the game before they can effectively respond.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and answering threats with a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. It also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Traverse the Ulvenwald for card advantage and consistency. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games. The deck aims to control the game until it can stabilize and win with powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Emrakul, the Promised End. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolored spells and maximize consistency.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal, countermagic, and powerful planeswalker abilities. The key strategy is to establish board control using cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler, while generating card advantage with Yorion, Sky Nomad and Expressive Iteration. The deck also includes a variety of versatile creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, as well as finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Emrakul, the Promised End. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana through effects such as Amulet of Vigor, Arboreal Grazer, and Sakura-Tribe Elder in order to cast Primeval Titan and search for utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Cavern of Souls. The deck uses the synergy between lands like Simic Growth Chamber and bounce lands to generate additional mana and create explosive turns where it can play multiple big threats like Hydroid Krasis or Cultivator Colossus. The main win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and land synergy.

This deck focuses on overwhelming opponents with powerful elemental creatures and controlling the game with a variety of spells and abilities. The key strategy involves ramping up mana quickly, using cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate advantage, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage, utilizing powerful elemental synergies, and ultimately winning the game through a combination of creature aggression and control elements.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to manipulate the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage generators. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking cards for extra effects. The deck also incorporates a variety of powerful planeswalkers and versatile creatures to further establish control over the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multi-color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to use fast and aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide, combined with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Boros Charm, to quickly reduce the opponent's life total before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and finish them off with a flurry of burn spells. Additionally, cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel help punish the opponent for casting spells, further increasing the pressure on them.

The deck revolves around quickly equipping creatures with powerful artifacts like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to create overwhelming threats. It utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to tutor for key pieces, while also benefiting from cards like Puresteel Paladin to draw extra cards. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond. With the ability to generate explosive starts and powerful finishers, this deck is designed to win fast and decisively.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo by using Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic. The deck aims to equip creatures like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute with Colossus Hammer to create massive threats and quickly close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce helps protect the combo pieces from removal and disruption, while cards like Esper Sentinel and Shadowspear provide additional utility and ways to push damage through. The deck's flexible mana base allows for consistent casting of key combo pieces.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Archmage's Charm and Lightning Bolt. The deck utilizes efficient card selection and card advantage through spells like Consider and Expressive Iteration. By applying early pressure and maintaining control of the game with a mix of threats and answers, the deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize or mount a comeback.

The deck focuses on casting low-cost, efficient creatures and spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By using efficient removal spells and countermagic, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while continuing to apply pressure. The addition of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to maintain card advantage and selection, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive stance throughout the game. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. This allows the player to cast powerful colorless threats like Walking Ballista, Emrakul, the Promised End, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes control elements such as Oblivion Stone and Karn Liberated to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Ancient Stirrings and Sylvan Scrying help find key pieces of the Tron lands. The deck aims to overpower opponents with its efficient mana production and powerful threats.

The deck is focused on creating a fast-paced aggressive strategy using small creature cards and efficient removal options. It also utilizes the Land Urza's Saga for additional value and consistency. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional card advantage and flexibility in the deck. This Weenie White Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures while disrupting their game plan with removal spells and protecting its own creatures with protection spells. The deck also includes equipment cards to provide additional power and evasion to its creatures.
